map.1/C=N/Ci 几何均值的倒数；N 个相等电容串联 = 1/N 倍单电容。本工: 1/C=N/Ci is the reciprocal of the geometric mean; N equal capacitors in series give 1/N of a single capacitor. This tool is an aid for basic electromagnetics and circuit work; results are for teaching and preliminary design reference only and do not replace formal engineering design, EMC standards or a licensed engineer's judgement.

map.串联电容总电容减小。: Series capacitance decreases the total capacitance.
map.串联等效容量为何比最小者还小？: Why is the series equivalent smaller than the smallest one?
map.实际电容漏电阻差异大，长期串联时漏电流小的分更多电压，加均压电阻（几百 kΩ~M: Actual capacitors vary widely in leakage resistance, so in a long series string the low-leakage ones take more of the voltage; add equalizing resistors (hundreds of kΩ to MΩ) to balance them. map.电容串联计算器。输入多个电容值，按 1/C_eq = 1/C₁+1/C₂+… 求: Capacitor series calculator. Enter several capacitance values and compute the series equivalent capacitance from 1/C_eq = 1/C1 + 1/C2 + ...; in series the total capacitance decreases and the voltage rating rises, which is often used for high-voltage voltage division and for combining capacitors when a single part lacks the needed rating.
map.电容相等时均分电压；电容不等时小电容分更高电压（Q 相同时 V=Q/C），易击穿: Equal capacitances share the voltage equally; unequal ones put more voltage on the smaller capacitor (for equal charge V=Q/C), which is prone to breakdown. map.耦合电容：级间耦合阻断 DC。: Coupling capacitor: blocks DC between stages.
map.隔直电容：串联隔直流通交流。: DC blocking capacitor: in series to block DC while letting AC through.
map.高压储能：Marx 发生器串联成高压脉冲。: High-voltage energy storage: a Marx generator stacked in series produces high-voltage pulses.
map.高压电容分压：测高压交流（如阻容分压器）。: High-voltage capacitive divider: measures high-voltage AC (such as a resistive-capacitive divider).
map.：C=5μF；耐压相加（如各 25V→50V）；电荷相同 Q=C₁V₁=C₂V₂: : C=5uF; the voltage ratings add (e.g. 25V each -> 50V); the charge is the same, Q=C1*V1=C2*V2.
